text: Previously... Dave caught Chloe hugging a mystery man.
Day one of Operation Undercover. Dave disguises himself as a bush.
It's going perfectly... until the gardener shows up.
Day two. A trench coat, dark glasses, and a newspaper with eye holes.
Then a pigeon decides his hat is a nest.
Finally, he sneaks into the cafe, and hears Chloe whisper...
Then the tall stranger walks in. And he's... crying?
Dave? Is she... your girlfriend too?
